name: Tighnari / Yaoyao + Fischl + Beidou (Aggravate)

fields: Tighnari, Yaoyao, Fischl, Beidou kits: frames, mechanics

assumptions: No published rotation for this exact team: the rotation is ours. Yaoyao and the electro supports (Fischl, Beidou) apply Dendro/Electro and cast their own combo first to establish Quicken, then Tighnari (on-field) casts Skill (grants the fast-draw Vijnana Suffusion state) and repeatedly fires Wreath Arrow (his Charged Attack) until the rotation ends (length = Fischl's 25.3s skill cooldown).

The Quicken/Spread/Aggravate reaction itself needs no character-specific code (kb/mechanics/reactions.json: quicken/aggravate/spread, all implemented) — Tighnari's Dendro Charged Attack lands as Spread DMG on an already-Quickened target, and Fischl's/Beidou's Electro hits land as Aggravate DMG. Both scale with EM (additive reaction, kb/mechanics/reactions.json em.additive).

Tighnari's Charged Attack (Wreath Arrow) was missing entirely from the KB before this session (a bulk-import bug: the importer only recognised literally-named 'Charged Attack DMG'/'Fully-Charged Aimed Shot' labels, not his kit's own 'Wreath Arrow DMG'); it's now patched in (see kb/characters/tighnari.json), modelled as always fired right after Skill (the fast-draw case). His A1/A4 EM-scaling passives and constellations are not modelled.

Yaoyao, Fischl and Beidou are otherwise baseline/partly-patched: Yaoyao's Dendro application/healing passives and constellations are not modelled; Fischl's Oz and A4 follow gcsim (patched); Beidou's counter mechanic and constellations are not modelled.
Weapons default to the highest base ATK weapon of each type in the KB (no recommendation in the KB); no artifact set bonuses.
notes: Quicken team (community shorthand: 'Tighnari Aggravate'): Yaoyao's Radish/Yuegui and Fischl's/Beidou's Electro form Quicken; Tighnari's Dendro Charged Attack (Wreath Arrow) then Spreads while Fischl's and Beidou's own Electro hits Aggravate.
